# Freight Chain

> Freight Chain is a browser truck-driving game in the spirit of Desert Bus, with server-timed shifts and escrowed prize pools on Solana. It is a devnet build: nothing on it is real money. SOL / USDC funds the pools (85% weekly boards · 5% rollover · 10% Season Final, with player-derived funding capped < 50%). TEN4 is a separate capped coin (100,000,000 fixed supply) minted by verified paid checkpoints. HONK is the in-game verb.

You drive a long-hood semi with a manual gearbox, a cold engine, traffic and nights down a road that never ends. A shift takes real time and cannot be skipped or sped up. The server keeps the clock, records the drive and judges the finish. Training rides are free and unlimited, and every eligible wallet receives one weekly granted paid ticket (AMOE). Ahead of the 7-week Season 1 mainnet (Jan 11 – Feb 28, 2027), the Nov 2–17, 2026 Devnet Pre-season awards a $500 USDC organizer-funded prize pool on the 1 h board plus 100,000 TEN4 airdrop points. Anyone can watch a ride live, about 25 seconds behind, or replay a finished one.

What is live, built or only planned changes week to week – the whitepaper's "Status at a glance" table is the current answer.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://freightchain.fun/): the pitch, live boards (pot, trucks on the road, top 10, recent rides), the economy, the roadmap, an FAQ
- [Whitepaper](https://whitepaper.freightchain.fun/): how to drive, rides and rules, rewards, the escrow program on Solana, validation and anti-cheat, live streams and replays, limits and risks
- [Play](https://ride.freightchain.fun/play.html): the free run in the browser – no wallet, no download
